title: A is for Adam — The First Man God Made
memory_verse: "God made Adam from the dust of the ground." — Genesis 2:7
objective: Students will learn the letter A and the Bible word Adam, the first person God created.
content: Today we are learning the letter A! Can you say A? A is for Adam!
Adam was the very first man. God made Adam out of the dust of the ground and breathed life into him. How amazing is that!
God put Adam in a beautiful garden called the Garden of Eden. Adam got to name all the animals! God loved Adam very much, and God loves you too.
activity: Color a picture of the letter A. Draw a picture of Adam in the garden with animals around him.
discussion: Can you say the letter A?
Who was the first man God made?
What did Adam get to do with the animals?
